_label: SYNTHETIC CASES authored for plan kensaku-v1-2 (EV-019). Expected Stripe Checkout Session create parameters for stripe@23.1.0, apiVersion 2026-10-28.endive (research/stripe-2026-11-23.md S1-S27). Not captured from a live Stripe call. Frozen at approval.

rules.builder: buildCheckoutSessionRequest(order, { port, now }) in src/commerce/session-request.ts returns { params, options }. The test deep-equals both against each case's expected value. No other parameter may be present.
rules.name: line_items[].price_data.product_data.name = 'Simulated: ' + productName, where productName is trimmed, cut to its first 120 Unicode code points, and trimmed again at the end.
rules.description: line_items[].price_data.product_data.description = 'Simulated Kensaku purchase in a Stripe sandbox. No order is placed with <merchantHost> and no real payment is taken. Demo price copied from the price last observed on <merchantHost> at <retrievedAt>.' with retrievedAt as stored (ISO 8601).
rules.currency: Lowercase ISO code, set on the session and on every price_data. unit_amount is the line's demoUnitAmountMinor.
rules.urls: success_url = http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?checkout=success&order=<orderId>&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} (the braces are literal; Stripe substitutes them). cancel_url = http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?checkout=cancelled&order=<orderId>.
rules.expiry: expires_at = floor(now / 1000) + 1800 (30 minutes, Stripe's minimum, S13).
rules.fixed: mode 'payment'; adaptive_pricing { enabled: false } (no conversion, S19); client_reference_id = orderId; metadata and payment_intent_data as in the cases. No payment_method_types (removed in stripe 23, S7), no customer, no images, no allowed_payment_method_types.
